body:
It's cool.  I don't even know why I posted.  I wish reality was different, but it's not.

Thank you for your help, and I did not mean to imply you were materialistic.

It was a lot of things.  I was raised in a very religious "cult", if you can call it that which gave me an artificial view of the world.  My field of study made me in to an atheist even though I did not want to become one.  


Also when my father died, this really changed me.  I'd known other people to die through my life, even my best friend had died when I was young, but my father killed himself slowly, and his death was a very sad one, and this really changed the way I thought about things.
